commit.message:
LU-18231 obd: change obd_no_transno into OBDF_NO_TRANSNO

Change the use of the obd_no_transno bitfield into a bit in
the obd_flags bitmap and use atomic bit set/clear/test
operations on it.
No logical changes to the code and no changes to locking.
